notes:
First release for the ESP32-C6-Touch-LCD-2.8.
Panel reset and backlight run through the board's CH32 I2C expander rather than GPIO.
The on-board RTC seeds the clock at boot, so a restart out of Internet reach is not stuck waiting for SNTP.
Temperature and humidity from the SHTC3 appear on the dashboard.
The touch panel is not used.
